import sys


def solve():

    if not input_data:
        return

    n = int(input_data[0])
    s = input_data[1]

    max_len = 1

    for i in range(n):
        # Palíndromo com centro no caractere i (comprimento ímpar)
        left = i
        right = i
        while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]:
            current_len = right - left + 1
            if current_len > max_len:
                max_len = current_len
            left -= 1
            right += 1

        # Palíndromo com centro entre os caracteres i e i+1 (comprimento par)
        left = i
        right = i + 1
        while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]:
            current_len = right - left + 1
            if current_len > max_len:
                max_len = current_len
            left -= 1
            right += 1

    print(max_len)
